messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Source link: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-024-45821-y
Paper DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-45821-y

Protocol details:

ASSAY TYPE: Tissue-Digital Microfluidic Isolation of Single Cells for -Omics (tDISCO) for Spatially-Resolved Single-Cell Transcriptomic and Proteomic Profiling of Proximal vs. Distal Astrocytes after Ischemic Stroke

REAGENTS USED:
  - Cryosectioned Brain Tissue Biopsy (2 mm diameter punch from a cortical stroke tissue section, mounted on the tDISCO top-plate)
  - Fixation Reagent (paraformaldehyde-based fixative, applied on-chip)
  - DAPI Nuclear Stain (marks all nuclei)
  - Anti-GFAP Antibody (fluorescent astrocyte marker)
  - Anti-NEUN Antibody (fluorescent neuronal marker)
  - Cell Lysis/Receiving Buffer (droplet positioned above the tissue for laser-induced single-cell lysis and lysate collection)

STEPS:
1. Mount a 2 mm cryosectioned cortical tissue biopsy onto the tDISCO top-plate.
2. Fix the mounted tissue biopsy in place on-chip using the fixation reagent.
3. Stain the fixed tissue on-chip with DAPI, anti-GFAP, and anti-NEUN to mark nuclei, astrocytes, and neurons, respectively.
4. Image the stained tissue at low magnification (20X) to map DAPI+/GFAP+ and DAPI+/NEUN+ cells and record their distance from the stroke lesion.
5. Select a single target cell (e.g., a GFAP+ astrocyte at a defined distance from the injury site) and re-image at high magnification (100X) to confirm its identity and position before lysis.
6. Dispense a receiving-buffer droplet and use digital microfluidic actuation to position it directly over the selected single cell.
7. Fire the focused laser at the targeted cell to induce a cavitation bubble that mechanically lyses the cell, releasing its contents into the overlying receiving-buffer droplet.
8. Actuate the single-cell lysate droplet away from the tissue for downstream -omics processing (library preparation for transcriptomics, or digestion for proteomics).
9. Replenish a fresh receiving-buffer droplet over the same tissue section and repeat steps 5-8 to iteratively isolate additional single cells (e.g., a second GFAP+ astrocyte at a different lesion distance, or a DAPI+/NEUN+ neuron) from the same biopsy.
10. Pool/queue the collected single-cell lysate droplets for transcriptomic (RNA-seq) and proteomic (LC-MS/MS) analysis, comparing molecular profiles across cells at varying distances from the stroke lesion to resolve the spatial boundaries of the astrocyte response.

module fluorescence

manifest cell_lysate
manifest nhsl1_antibody
manifest control_igg
manifest protein_a_beads
manifest wash_buffer
manifest laemmli_buffer
manifest secondary_hrp_antibody
manifest ecl_substrate

instructions:

// Preclear lysate with Protein A beads to remove non-specific binders
lysate = dispense 100 units of cell_lysate
preclear_beads = dispense 30 units of protein_a_beads
precleared = mix lysate with preclear_beads
heat precleared at 4c for 30m
dispose preclear_beads

// Negative control IP with non-immune IgG
igg = dispense 5 units of control_igg
igg_mix = mix precleared with igg
heat igg_mix at 4c for 120m

igg_beads = dispense 30 units of protein_a_beads
igg_complex = mix igg_mix with igg_beads
heat igg_complex at 4c for 60m

repeat 3 times {
    igg_wash = dispense 200 units of wash_buffer
    igg_washed = mix igg_complex with igg_wash
    dispose igg_washed
}

igg_elution_buffer = dispense 30 units of laemmli_buffer
igg_eluate = mix igg_complex with igg_elution_buffer
heat igg_eluate at 95c for 5m
dispose igg_eluate

// Specific IP with anti-NHSL1 antibody (pAb 4457)
ab = dispense 5 units of nhsl1_antibody
ip_mix = mix precleared with ab
heat ip_mix at 4c for 120m

ip_beads = dispense 30 units of protein_a_beads
ip_complex = mix ip_mix with ip_beads
heat ip_complex at 4c for 60m

repeat 3 times {
    ip_wash = dispense 200 units of wash_buffer
    ip_washed = mix ip_complex with ip_wash
    dispose ip_washed
}

elution_buffer = dispense 30 units of laemmli_buffer
eluate = mix ip_complex with elution_buffer
heat eluate at 95c for 5m

// Western blot detection step (anti-Abi1 / anti-WAVE2, HRP-ECL)
secondary = dispense secondary_hrp_antibody
substrate = dispense 20 units of ecl_substrate
detection_mix = mix eluate with secondary
blot_mix = mix detection_mix with substrate

coip_signal = detect fluorescence on blot_mix for 60s

if (coip_signal >= 80) {
    dispose blot_mix
} else {
    repeat 2 times {
        rewash = dispense 200 units of wash_buffer
        rewashed = mix blot_mix with rewash
        dispose rewashed
    }
    dispose blot_mix
}

bsbbr_2_h:

	ip_beads1[0] = dispense(protein_a_beads)

bsbbr_5_h:
	PHI ip_washed1 = {ip_washed0,ip_washed2}
	PHI ip_wash1 = {ip_wash0,ip_wash2}

bsbbif_10_j:
	NOP

	PHI REPEAT_21 = {REPEAT_20,REPEAT_22}

	if REPEAT_21[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_12_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_13_f

chemical_evidence.source_quote: three 2 mm tissue biopsies from a cryosectioned tissue slice
DAPI + NEUN+ neurons and DAPI + GFAP+ astrocytes were selected
digital microfluidics is used to collect this single cell and replenish the buffer droplet above the tissue

operation_evidence.bs_operation: fixed_tissue = mix biopsy with fix / stained_tissue = mix ... with dapi/gfap/neun
operation_evidence.source_quote: Biopsies are mounted onto an tDISCO top-plate, fixed and stained
a laser to create cavitation bubbles that mechanically release selected single cells
allowing for iterative lysis of individual cells from a single tissue

numeric_mismatches.field: stained_tissue re-used directly inside repeat loop
numeric_mismatches.note: The paper's tissue biopsy is a single physical object that remains mounted on the tDISCO top-plate across all lysis cycles; BioScript has no persistent-substrate primitive, so the biopsy is modeled as one reusable 'stained_tissue' handle mixed with a fresh buffer droplet each iteration, rather than a truly re-dispensed solid substrate.

Detection/disruption in the paper is a focused Q-switched laser pulse inducing a cavitation bubble, not a thermal/heating event. 'heat' is used here only because it is the closest disruptive primitive exposed by BioScript's grammar; the 25c/1s values are placeholders and do not represent a measured laser parameter.

Cell selection in the paper is performed via AI-driven fluorescence image analysis (DAPI/GFAP/NEUN channels) to map marker-positive cells and their lesion distance, not a single scalar fluorescence intensity threshold; 'detect fluorescence >= 80' is a simplified stand-in for this image-based decision.
Represents iterative single-cell isolation from one tissue section; the paper does not report a fixed number of cells collected per biopsy, so 3 is an illustrative placeholder, not a reported value.

metadata.notes: This protocol details Tissue-Digital Microfluidic Isolation of Single Cells for -Omics (tDISCO) for Spatially-Resolved Single-Cell Transcriptomic and Proteomic Profiling of Proximal vs. Distal Astrocytes after Ischemic Stroke. The assay is performed on a Digital Microfluidics (DMF) platform. Key reagents used in the assay include Cryosectioned Brain Tissue Biopsy and Fixation Reagent.
